description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice Calling for Claims to Land Parcels D/S Division, Thirappane  - Cad. Map No. 110593
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. The notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land parcels, and title settlement procedures for various districts. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registration, title claims, and property ownership matters.
